note: McLean County's Myer Creek Park outside Calhoun, with a 4-H arena, riding trails and picnic shelters. Camping is around the bath house and along the entrance road; a further set of shaded RV sites in the lower woods was being built for seasonal use. The county page gives no way to reserve: call ahead. --Claude

County page read via headless browser: RV $10 water-only / $15 30A / $20 50A, 3-day limit (new max_stay 3), showers + dump confirmed; site count 30 (note prose) replaced by a sites note (24 W/E + water-only + 14 120v). flags: FEES: low 15 -> 10: the page's cheapest RV site is 'RV - no electrical hookup/only water: $10/day' (an RV site a 23-ft rig fits); high 20 confirmed. Local park, no price gate. The county page is undated (its photo set is headed 2023).
MAX STAY: 'Camping Around Bath House and Park Entrance: (3 Day Limit)' -> booking.max_stay_nights 3 (new).

SITES: stored count 30 came from sweep note prose ('~30 sites'); the page lists 12 50A + 12 30A water/electric RV sites, an unstated number of water-only RV sites and 14 '120v/water nearby' sites - count cleared, the breakdown put in sites.note. The page also describes ~28-30 more shaded RV sites under construction in the lower woods 'for seasonal use'; imagery shows pads cut into the woods south-east of the bath house, but whether they are open is not stated anywhere.

PHONE 270-499-8775: not found on any county page or in a web search - unsourced. The only number the county posts is the courthouse, (270) 273-3213 (footer of the park page). Suggest '270-499-8775' -> '270-273-3213' unless the stored number has a source elsewhere.

PRESENCE (local): the county tourism page with current-looking rates is the only official presence; it is undated, gives no reservation method, no season and no phone for the park. No Google Maps place listing exists (only the road), RV Life lists it with 0 reviews. A county park with an official rate page passes the local presence rule, but thinly - reviewer may want a call-first caveat (added to the note).
HORSE: the park has horseback riding trails and a 4-H riding arena, but no horse camping is mentioned; the camping is ordinary RV/tent sites - not a horse-rule problem.
SEASON: not stated on any page - left unknown.
WATERFRONT not waterfront: holds (a small pond ~400 m NW of the bath house; the 'lake' with a new access road is not near the RV sites).
